RHEOGRAPH Add-On
With the RHEOGRAPH, we offer a flexible platform for the characterization of polymers. The capillary rheometer serves as a basic istrument to which various additional add-ons can be added on a modular basis.
Customized enquiryProduct brochure
Modular and flexible
Extend your capillary rheometer
The RHEOGRAPH can be optimally adapted to the individual requirements of each application. In the full configuration, the processing behaviour can be comprehensively characterized.
The basic GÖTTFERT capillary rheometer is designed to carry out viscosity measurements with plastics, rubbers and other materials.
Modular add-ons offer additional options for the characterization of materials.
Success Story: Our testing instruments in use
Roundtable: Know-how directly from our lab
NORMAL STRESS DIE
Measuring first normal stress difference at high shear rates via capillary rheometer.
Determination of Normal Stress at high shear rates and closer to the processing shear rates which was not possible with conventional technique​
Detection of flow instabilities at processing shear rates​
Measurement of Viscosity, elongation viscosity and Normal Stress differences​
SHARK SKIN
The Shark Skin measuring head is mounted at the bottom of the test barrel instead of the capillary. With this option it is possible to measure exactly at which critical shear rates surface inhomogeneities occur.
Detection of the Shark Skin effect
Consisting of slit die, three high frequency pressure-sensors (sampling rate up to 20 kHZ), as well as software package
Determination of the frequency spectrum and statistical evaluation of the pressure signal
Optimization in the extrusion, film and coating process
THERMAL CONDUCTIVITY
The sensor for thermal conductivity is mounted just like a standard piston. The barrel is closed at the bottom during the test. The thermal conductivity measurement of solids or melt is performed under stationary conditions.
Determination of the thermal conductivity at a measuring range up to 450°C and 1000 bar
Developed according to ASTM D5930
Test sensor with integrated heating element and temperature sensor
Process-Simulation and optimization of cycle times in injection molding
No mechanical modifications necessary
Fully automatic measurement
CONTIFEED
The CONTIFEED is a mini-extruder which directly feeds the test barrel of a capillary rheometer. This add-on is particularly suitable for thermally unstable material, due to the reduced dwell time. The plasticizing with pre-shearing in the extruder, makes the measuring process very similar to the production process.
The advantages of the CONTIFEED:
Automated, bubble-free filling of the test barrel
Influence of plasticizing via extruder can be investigated
Shorter material dwell time under temperature influence
Rheological characterization at conditions similar to the production process
Pre-plastification also allows the measurement of powder materials (e.g. PVC dry blends)
PVT (ISOTHERMAL/ISOBARIC) 
Besides the PVT 500, GÖTTFERT also offers the PVT-measurement as an add-on for the capillary rheometer. The measurement characterizes the material specific dependencies between pressure, specific volume and temperature.
Isothermal or isobaric measurements according to ISO 17744
Constant high cooling rate with newly developed air cooling or thermostat
Fully automated measurement
Automatically generated PVT diagram
Parameterization with Tait model as interface to simulation software
Principle of pVT measurement (isothermal)
Principle of pVT measurement (isobaric)
RHEOTENS
The drawability of polymer melts is of utmost importance in many processes of plastics production and processing.
The patented RHEOTENS method has proven to be an extremely sensitive measuring principle that delivers highly reproducible results to show even minimal batch fluctuations.
In addition to the already existing constant speed and constant acceleration, exponential acceleration is now also possible. The determination of the extensional viscosity function according to Prof. Wagner is an integral part of the RHEOTHENS.
The RHEOTENS is well suited as a processability test for materials used in extrusion or film applications.
HAUL-OFF
Our newly developed HAUL-OFF with a maximum speed of 2000 m/min is particularly suited for the characterization of fibre-grade materials. The system can be operated with constant acceleration or at constant speed steps. The pull-down force is measured via a smooth-running, anti-stick coated measuring wheel on a highly sensitive force transducer.
DIE SWELL MEASUREMENT
The measuring head is mounted below the die. The measurement can be carried out parallel to a viscosity measurement.
Determination of the dynamic and static die swell
Evaluation of a die swell profile (BASELL method)
Swivel arm with continuous height adjustment
Laser measuring head in 0.1 μm or 7 μm version
Optional with automatic melt cutting device
Optional: acquisition of two strings simultaneously
Application: Simulation of material swelling behaviour during extrusion
COUNTER PRESSURE CHAMBER
The viscosity of polymers can also depend on the general pressure level. The Counter Pressure Chamber is mounted behind the die and generates a back-pressure at the die outlet, which is measured with an additional pressure sensor.
Determining the pressure dependence of viscosity (pressure coefficient)
Determination of the critical wall shear stress for wall slip
Maximum pressure (Pm) 1200 bar
Temperature range up to 400°C
Optimization of the flow processes in processing machines (injection molding and extrusion tools with long flow paths, melt pumps)

Rotational Online-Rheometer
Measuring system for continuous, real-time monitoring of viscoelastic properties
Online-Rheometer ROR
Determination of viscoelastic properties of polymer melts
A Rotational Online Rheometer (ROR) is an industrial proven testing instrument integrated to an lab extruder to continuously measure the viscoelastic properties of fluids or polymer melts in real time. Unlike traditional lab rheometers that require manual sample collection, or capillary process rheometers that measure steady shear viscosity, an ROR provides instantaneous feedback on molecular structure (e.g., molecular weight distribution, branching) and flow behavior without manual sample collection and preparation.
Success Story: Our testing instruments in use
Roundtable: Know-how directly from our lab
Good to know
While conventional rotational rheometers in the lab mainly capture polymer structure at low frequencies, and capillary rheometers describe flow behavior at high shear rates, the ROR combines the advantages of both approaches:
fast, process-relevant data on polymer structure and flow behavior in real-time.
Method
Continuous characterization of viscoelastic material properties (G’ and G”)
Material feeding by lab extruder, gear pump, drumunloader or any other feeding unit
Product features
Oscillation frequency 0,1-50Hz
Oscillation deformation ±0,01° (±) – ∞; Rotation
Maximum circular frequency 314 1/s
Maximum shear rate in transient mode 500 s-1
Measurement up to 350°C 
Applications
Materials: Polymer melts or any kind of material which can be extruded or feeded to the Rotational Online Rheometer
Frequency sweep
Amplitude sweep
Temperature sweep
Ramp- Relaxation test with continuous deformation angle
Transient Viscosity with continuous rotation
Measurement at different hydrostatic pressures (pressurized measurement up to 400bar)

AT-LINE Rheometer
Continuous measurement of powder, fine granules or pellets for monitoring polymerization processes
AT-LINE Rheometer
Modular platform for advanced characterization of polymers
The Online-Rheometer measuring heads are mounted on a GÖTTFERT lab scale extruder and are supplied with melt. The material feeding of the small extruder is fully automated by our Online Samplers.
Success Story: Our testing instruments in use
Roundtable: Know-how directly from our lab
Good to know
The complete line initially consists of a combination of Online-Rheometer such as MBR, SSR, or RTR/RTS-TD and a preceding EXTRUSIOMETER, which serves as the melt feeder. With an optionally self-operating material feed (Online-Sampler), reliable continuous operation is ensured.
Specification
Product features
Further measuring systems are possible:
Mini-Bypass-Rheograph (MBR)
Side-Line-Rheometer (SSR)
Real-Time-Rheometer (RTR/RTS)
Rotational Online-Rheometer (ROR)
Additional Add-Ons:
→ Flat Film Unit 
→ Optical Measurement
→ Filter Measurement Head
→ Online-Sampling

Laboratory Extruder
Our Laboratory Extruders simulate the entire extrusion process under real conditions. They enable continuous measurements of viscosity, shear rate and shear stress - ideal for the development of new materials and the optimization of manufacturing processes.
Real-time analysis
Optimum material processing
Our laboratory extruders simulate the entire extrusion process under real conditions. They enable continuous measurements of viscosity, shear rate and shear stress - ideal for the development of new materials and the optimization of manufacturing processes.
With almost 50 years of experience in rheological extrusion technology, our laboratory extruders set standards in the precise characterization of plastics and elastomers. Our laboratory extruders offer maximum flexibility thanks to customizable barrel diameters and lengths as well as tailor-made barrel systems.
Individual configuration - Choose from different pressure sensor positions and melt temperature detection.
Efficient cooling - Water cooling prevents unwanted material plastification in the feed area.
Precise torque measurement - Complements the system for versatile applications.
Real-time data analysis - Continuous acquisition of shear rate, shear stress and viscosity.
Overview of our products
The X-trude series offers models with extended torque options (X-trude 300, 600 and 1400 nM) which, in combination with downstream systems, provide an open platform for online-rheological-analysis.

X-trude 300
Compact design, high measuring accuracy and flexible adjustment options characterize the X-trude 300. Ideal for reliable rheological analyses and the optimization of manufacturing processes.
Product brochure
Laboratory Extruder x-trude 300
Precise and efficient extrusion testing
The X-trude 300 is the ideal solution for precise material analysis and small production quantities. With a torque of 300 Nm and an output of 5.18 kW, it is perfect for research, development and quality control. Thanks to flexible piston and screw configurations and precise temperature control, it delivers reliable measured values for viscosity, melting behavior and rheological properties.
Its compact design allows easy integration into existing laboratory processes.
Good to know
GÖTTFERT extrusiometers are compact laboratory extruders for testing and processing polymers. They can be used as melt dispensers for online rheometers to measure the melt index, MVR or viscosity. They are also suitable for downstream units, e.g. for film analysis (ALS). In the highest configuration level, they can be used as fully automatic measuring extruders (ALR) with continuous material feed (online sampler) - ideal for comprehensive rheological analyses.
Specification
 Product features
Completely newly developed torque ranges
300Nm torque with 5.18 kW output power
Various cylinder and screw designs
Up to 16 heating and 3 cooling zones
0-350° temperature curve with 0.1°C resolution and a calibration accuracy of less than 0.4%
Pressure sensor measuring range: 0 - 100, -200, -500, -1000 bar with a deviation of +/- 0.5% from the target value
Control via external PC or optionally with integrated touch panel
Visualization via “ROSWin” software
User-specific adaptations possible
